description.value: St. Joseph's Catholic Church is the oldest church in Kamloops, built jointly by Catholic missionaries and the Tk'emlups te Secwepemc in the late 19th century on Tk'emlups band lands near the industrial park. Designated a Canadian heritage site, it has been fully renovated with artifacts restored, including a striking gold-gilded altar. For a touring cyclist with an interest in Indigenous and colonial history, it represents a rare surviving piece of early Kamloops cultural heritage.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at rcdk.org/st-joseph-s confirms this is a real, active heritage site — the oldest church in Kamloops, built in the late 19th century, designated a Canadian heritage site with a restored gold-gilded altar. No cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The tourism=museum OSM tag appears to reflect its heritage designation, but the site is an active parish church with mass only on the first Sunday of each month, limiting general visitor access.
concerns: OSM tags this as tourism=museum but it is an active parish church; the museum tag likely reflects Canadian heritage designation rather than a standalone museum operation.
Website lists two phone numbers (250-372-2581 and 250-374-7323); primary number used above, secondary number 250-374-7323 omitted.
OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only, not cross-checked against OSM.
Very limited public access hours (mass first Sunday of each month); unclear whether the site is open for general tourist visits outside of mass.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The site is a genuine heritage attraction of cultural significance, but visitor access is highly limited (mass first Sunday of each month only) and no cyclist amenities are documented. Needs review to determine whether the directory includes passive points of interest with no confirmed cycling infrastructure.
enrichment_extras.notes: A second contact phone number appears on the website: 250-374-7323. The Chancery Office (diocesan admin) contact is separate: 250-376-3351, info@rcdk.org, 635A Tranquille Road, Kamloops, BC V2B 3H5.

wow_evidence: Kamloops' oldest church, built with the Tk'emlups te Secwepemc, Canadian heritage designation, restored gold-gilded altar; sits within the Tk'emlups lands near the former residential school — read alongside that separate row.
blurb: Kamloops' oldest church, restored on Tk'emlups lands with its gilded altar intact.
